selector.why: The history of radiation therapy to the breast and the development of a new mass in the irradiated field, as noted in the evidence for Radiation-induced sarcoma, decided it.

frontier_selector.why: The history of radiation therapy to the breast and the development of a new mass in the irradiated field, as noted in the evidence for Radiation-induced sarcoma, decided it.

support_spans: Six years earlier, she had undergone breast-conserving surgery with endocrine therapy and radiation (50 Gy in 25 fractions) to the left breast for an upper inner quadrant carcinoma
there was a 20 mm firm mass fixed to the pectoralis major muscle
On three-month follow-up, the lesion had increased in size
Ultrasonography revealed a lobulated, well-defined mass measuring 17.5 × 16.4 × 10.6 mm with relatively hypoechoic, heterogeneous internal echoes
contradict_spans: A core-needle biopsy of the lesion suggested only atrophic mammary glands
